''I present a limerick as written by [[Mat Cauthon]].''

There once was an equine called [[Pips]]<br />
I bought after cashing my chips.<br />
We rode to the [[Aiel Waste|Waste]].<br />
My neck got misplaced.<br />
And now the [[Band of the Red Hand|Band]] - ''[[Oosquai|oosquai]]'' it sips.
